string-array.item: More Languages Supported: Chinese, French, German, Hindi, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, and Spanish.
Rich Text: Make words bold or italic in your script.
Text sizes set in points, with presets scaled to your screen.
Select All in the editor\'s cue bar.
The play button counts down before your script starts.
The floating window\'s timer grows with its text.
Separate Settings for the editor and the teleprompter, with a way to share CueCard.
